purpose: Bind the historical exchange-clock evidence used to assign prior-evening bars to the following exchange trading day for the frozen source-validation samples.

trading_day_semantics.fact: A trading day starts with the previous workday's continuous trading and ends with the current day session.

facts: SHFE continuous trading for copper/aluminum/lead/zinc launched on 2013-12-20.
For the frozen 2016-06-15, 2018-06-15 and 2020-06-15 samples, CU continuous trading is 21:00-01:00.
RB continuous trading launched on 2014-12-26 at 21:00-01:00.
SHFE announced on 2016-04-26 that RB/HRC/fuel-oil/bitumen continuous trading was shortened from 21:00-01:00 to 21:00-23:00.
All three frozen RB sample dates are after that shortening and therefore use 21:00-23:00.

I.document: Dalian Futures Market, 2019 Issue 3, published by Dalian Commodity Exchange
facts: DCE initially operated night trading at 21:00-02:30.
On 2015-05-08 the night-session end was shortened to 23:30.
In March 2019 it was shortened again to 23:00.
Therefore frozen I1609 and I1809 samples use 21:00-23:30; frozen I2009 uses 21:00-23:00.

holiday_rule: For SHFE/DCE, an absent night session must remain absent; no prior-night values are forward-filled across national-holiday suspension dates.
